subject: Renewal paperwork: sequencing exhibits, orderform & expiry term realignment
messages:
From: Tom Harris <tharris@skyline.ai>

Cc: Amrita Sen <asen@skyline.ai>, Skyline AI Legal <legal@skyline.ai>

Subject: Renewal redlines and sequencing question

Hey Irene,

Thanks again for the chat this morning. We've put together our redline pass on the renewal package — mostly focused on the term expiry alignment between the MSA and the new orderform, plus a request to preserve our existing data retention carve-out.

Attached: Skyline_Renewal_Redline_20261216.docx (track changes) and a short capacity snapshot. Our commercial team also flagged the coverage sequencing: they want the orderform effective date to align with the start of their fiscal quarter (01-Feb-2027) rather than the MSA anniversary.

Can your legal team confirm whether we can (a) push the orderform effective date without changing the MSA expiration mechanics, or (b) would we need a short addendum to temporarily align terms? We want to avoid re-signing the full MSA if possible.

Proposed next step: quick legal/ops sync this week and then a canary DocuSign for the orderform if we agree the addendum path.

—Tom
Tom Harris
Head of Platform Partnerships, Skyline AI

Tom — thanks for the redline. I uploaded the doc and shared with our legal team. High level: we should be able to avoid a full MSA re-execution by doing a short addendum that (i) confirms the MSA stays in force, (ii) sets the orderform effective date to 2027-02-01, and (iii) clarifies coverage sequencing for invoicing and capacity-burst credits.

Hooking in Karthik and Lauren to confirm the drafting approach and the operational handoff for billing/usage cutover. Can Karthik confirm scope for the addendum (sample language or exhibit reference) and whether the existing termination/renewal clause needs a temporary waiver?

Irene

[Attachment: RI-Orderform-v3-annotated.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Tom Harris <tharris@skyline.ai>, Skyline AI Legal <legal@skyline.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 08:26:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal redlines and sequencing question

Folks — reviewed the redline. Quick replies: 

- Addendum approach is cleanest. Draft will: reference the executed MSA, set the orderform effective date to 2027-02-01, and include a one-time schedule that maps capacity usage buckets during the cutover month.
- We do not recommend a permanent amendment to the MSA termination clause; instead, include a short sentence that for the period 2027-02-01 through 2027-02-28 the orderform billing period is deemed aligned to the orderform effective date for purposes of invoicing and credits. This preserves the MSA mechanics while accommodating the customer's fiscal start.
- Need confirmation from Ops on whether we'll pro-rate any committed units for Jan 2027 or treat Jan as a holdover month. Lauren?

I'll draft the addendum template and share redline-ready language by EOD Friday. I'll include an exhibit that references the SOW_capacity_table.xlsx so the customer can sign off on units.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_capacity_table.xlsx]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tharris@skyline.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal redlines and sequencing question

Karthik — ops prefers treating Jan as a holdover month with no extra committed billing. We'll provision capacity and monitor consumption; any actual overages in Jan will be billed at standard overage rates and credited against Feb's usage if needed. That keeps invoicing simple and avoids messing with current commitments.

Tom — does that approach work for Skyline from a forecasting and billing perspective? If yes, we'll include the short addendum language and a billing exhibit, then route to DocuSign for signature.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Final addendum plan & DocuSign path

Tom — thanks for the quick answers. Per the thread:

1) We will proceed with a single-page addendum that references the MSA (no full re-execution) and sets the orderform effective date to 2027-02-01.
2) Jan 2027 will be treated as a holdover month; capacity will be available, overages billed at published rates and credited to Feb if needed.
3) Karthik has prepared the draft addendum and the SOW exhibit (attached). Please review the highlighted clauses in the addendum PDF; if sign-off, we will push to DocuSign and target signature by 2026-12-28 so finance can close the renewal in this quarter.
